_note: Counts exactly as reported in the four companion preprints (4 Nov 2026), not re-derived here. Paper codes: GS = From Gauge to Shelter (Chiang Mai); RP = Rain to Phone (national flood feeds, Nan event); NH = Nobody Owns the Haze (national PM2.5/fire feeds); NST = The Last Mile Is Institutional (Nakhon Si Thammarat).

gs_unreadable_resources.label: Open-data resources that could not be parsed into a table

gs_datasets_older_than_1y.label: Datasets not updated within a year (311 - 131)

gs_shelters_with_coordinates.label: Official shelter rows carrying a coordinate

gs_shelters_over_toilet_reference.label: Shelters reporting toilets that exceed 20 people per toilet

nst_metadata_older_than_1y.label: Catalog records last updated over a year earlier

nst_updated_on_24th.label: Provincial-office records stamped on the 24th of a month

nst_water_not_fresh_2h.label: Water-level records without an observation in the last two hours

nst_rain_not_fresh_2h.label: Rain-station records without an observation in the last two hours

rp_gauges_impossible_bank.label: Water-level gauges carrying bank levels that cannot be right

nh_stations_in_bangkok.label: National PM2.5 stations located in Bangkok

nh_forecast_warnings_missed.label: Forecast haze warnings that never reached the Thai 24-hour standard at any station
